platform: Bromcom cloud SaaS and web-based MIS hosted on Microsoft Azure, with native iOS and Android apps.

distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Links pupil, staff, purchasing, budgeting, statutory finance and parent payments in one cloud platform.
Trust teams can consolidate data across Bromcom and non-Bromcom schools, drill down and cascade configuration.
Staff can draft lesson plans, quizzes, homework and communications, translate content and automatically mark approved quizzes.
Rules based on attendance, behaviour, assessment and demographics can trigger cohorts, alerts, letters and follow-ups.
Supports DfE, workforce, Welsh, Catholic and CFR/EFSA reporting aligned to UK school requirements.
Parents can manage information, consent, appointments and payments for multiple children from one account.

weaknesses.issue: Trustpilot complaints cite slow loading, crashes, login problems, confusing interface and difficult reporting.
Mobile app reviews report login failures, lag, homework and timetable problems, and crashes.
A Teacher App review reported crashes while taking registers.
Public pricing is quote-based; available detailed G-Cloud prices are dated, complicating budgeting.
September 2026 SSO-registration incident involved unauthorised access to some registration email addresses.
Independent enterprise-user review evidence is thin, with no verified G2 reviews found.

ai_features: Drafts lesson plans, quizzes, homework, letters and emails
Supports multilingual translation and tone or length controls
Internal-data insights and pupil-report summaries are described as coming soon
pricing_model_summary: Quote-based per-pupil packages; dated February 2025 G-Cloud schedule lists MIS and Finance rates. Support, onboarding, payments, SMS and SMTP may add costs.
biggest_strategic_gap: Native transport, library, boarding, alumni and full payroll are not evidenced; OneRoster, LTI and Ed-Fi certification is also unverified.
